name: Camphor + Menthol + Oil Clove + Oil Eucalyptus + Oil Turpentine
indication_description: Stiffness, Congestion, Muscle aches, Sprains, Strains, Back pain, Joint pain, Cold, Flu, Catarrh, Headache
pharmacology_description: Camphor acts as a cough suppressant & topical analgesic. Eucalyptus Oil acts as a cough suppressant. Menthol acts as a acts as cough suppressant & topical analgesic
dosage_description:
Topical: Rub gently 3-4 mintues on the chest and back 2-3 times daily. Cover the rubbed area with warm clothes.

Inhalation: 1 tsf of ointment to be dissolved in boiled water and inhale the steam by mouth or nose as required.
interaction_description: There are no known drug interactions and none well documented.
contraindications_description: Children under 3 years. History of convulsion.
side_effects_description: Redness, irritation, rash or pruritis may occur with sensitive skin.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: Pregnancy Category-Not Classified. FDA has not yet classified the drug into a specified pregnancy category.
precautions_description: Avoid contact with eyes. Should not be applied to wounds or damaged skin. Wash hand thoroughly after applying.
